name: mirage
text:
v1.0.130 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.130
It blocks by-hand bets on any type that has lost with 300+ bets and a clear margin, and those bets no longer show in the Feed or the CNO list. Today that means player prop overs and NFL player props.
You asked for only profitable or even types. I did not widen the block to every type with a negative result, because under about 300 bets that is mostly noise and would hide good bets too. The engine's own types are already limited to props, moneylines and team totals, with bids on props and team totals only.
For fills I turned on many small bids. Next I'll read how many bids filled over the last day and what held the rest back, then loosen whatever blocks fills without losing +EV.
